required_substrings: Each item links to its original source

layouts._note: presend_check.py picks the layout by marker. Big Story marker: <!-- layout: big-story --> (or data-layout="big-story"). No marker = standard. required_substrings above apply to both layouts; the list below is added per layout.

big-story.data_centers: optional (only with strong new USA items)

scoreboard_layout.note: Every card: category pill, status pill, linked title, one-line explainer, big No. 1 score, Top 3 with bars, 2-line note, one-line This week. No SWE-bench. LMArena headline card stays above the grid. Desktop 2x3 at max-width 900px (card ~406, height 390); mobile stacks to 1 col via .si-card display:block. Big 3 cards 1+2 and data-center cards 1+2 sit 2-across via .si-pair on wide screens. Body/notes/Top3/This week text 15px/22px to match Big 3.

outlook.fluid_layout: outer content width=100% max-width:900px; MSO ghost table width=900; @media max-width:600px stacks WHW + scoreboard/pair cards, body text >=15px, titles ~20px; desktop: Big 3 + data centers 2-across via .si-pair; scoreboard 2x3; Big 3 / data-center / scoreboard body text 15px/22px
outlook.tags: plain-text with middot separators; no background pill boxes
outlook.icons: emoji only; no colored square behind icons
outlook.whw_layout: 2-column table desktop (WHAT HAPPENED / WHY IT MATTERS label width=122); stacks label above text on mobile via .si-label/.si-text-col
outlook.read_more: plain underlined text link (Outlook-safe) or VML bulletproof button
outlook.header: solid bgcolor=#0f1f3d on header td/table; keep gradient in style; MSO VML solid navy fill best-effort for desktop Outlook dark; force light text via class/data-ogsc
outlook.bgcolor_every_td: every td/table has solid bgcolor (#FAF8F3 body/cards or #0f1f3d header)
outlook.ios_outlook_dark_note: Outlook iOS may still force a dark purple surface despite color-scheme=light + data-ogsc/bgcolor; if so, stop chasing — keep text readable on forced dark via .si-on-dark / header light text
outlook.body_font: 15px/22px Big 3, data centers, scoreboard card body/notes/Top3/This week
